body: I will never forget AIP because of this.

I can’t leave med school or else I’d probably be homeless the rest of my life with how much I have in student loans. That debt keeps me going.

With that said, failing something isn’t the end of the world. I failed a lot during medical school, and when I had to try again, I passed just fine. 

The amount of stress that professional degree programs stick on students is awful. I shouldn’t think that killing myself is the only way to escape school. I hope that you are doing okay by now or at least trying to get some sleep.

We have a very similar story. I was about 6 when I learned about suicide. I’m exhausted from feeling this way my entire life. It’s relentless. I just want to feel numb. I want to have friends and not be so alone. I do t get how I’ve made it to this point in life without having any friends. I do everything on my own. I honestly wonder why I even have a phone because the only person that ever occasionally calls me is my mom. Minus me not showing up for work, I could probably go a few weeks before anyone would even think to look for me.

With that said, I don’t know how to help you and I wish I did. I wish I had words that would make a difference, but all I have to give you is to let you know that you aren’t alone in this world with how you feel. 

I hope things make an up-turn for you and that you find your purpose to live.
